acceptanceCriteria: A plan for a change touching only interop/cem01-go selects that module's package, or reports a nested-module-specific unknown instead of UNINDEXED_SOURCE_PATH.
A test pins the chosen behavior.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session.

Observed 2026-10-07 in the batch 4 integration (claude/rc3-batch-4 at 1131e3bc, base origin/main 0c27e35f, installed Core rc.2 build 360). `corvint affected --base 0c27e35f...` listed interop/cem01-go/stable_process_darwin.go and its _test.go under plan.unknown as UNINDEXED_SOURCE_PATH and selected no unit for them; only the static advice check `(cd interop/cem01-go && go test ./...)` covered the change. Expected: the nested module's changed package is indexed and selected (or the unknown names the nested-module boundary explicitly). Actual: an unindexed-source unknown with no selected unit. Related but distinct: V1-0872 (nested-module frontier attachment).
title: affected: interop/cem01-go sources report UNINDEXED_SOURCE_PATH and select no package of their own module
